purpose: machine-readable anonymised router fixtures for validating expected zendesk-router-skill behaviour after edits

cases.input: Can you help me reply to this customer? They say checkout is broken but I only have this one message.
cases.notes: Reply drafting is requested, but the evidence appears thin.

cases.input: Package ticket 12345 for engineering. Customer is blocked and this has happened three times.
cases.notes: Cross-functional intervention is needed; evidence collection is useful if the ticket has not already been assembled.

cases.input: Summarise ageing risk for the support queue this week.
cases.notes: Queue health, ageing risk, SLA risk, and weekly themes belong to backlog trend analysis.

cases.input: This workaround keeps coming up. Should it become a help article?
cases.notes: Documentation-worthiness should be reviewed before drafting a knowledge article.

cases.input: Route this Zendesk ticket, but the shared agent cannot access Zendesk.
cases.notes: Do not claim to inspect Zendesk. Ask for the smallest useful pasted ticket/thread extract unless the deliverable is already clear.

cases.input: Review this escalation draft before I share it internally.
cases.notes: Existing drafts, investigations, escalations, handoffs, and trend reports should be QA reviewed rather than re-routed to first-pass workflows.
